# Source

Pack: Electric FX
Original author: Binbun / Binbun3D
Original page: https://binbun3d.itch.io/electric-fx
Public GitHub mirror used for this import: https://github.com/us3cus/shapeshift-gamejam
Mirror path: addons/BinbunVFX/ElectricFXFree/assets/BinbunVFX_Vol2/ElectricFX
License: CC0 1.0 Universal

Import policy:
- only the freely available pack content is staged here;
- files whose names identify paid/full showcase scenes are excluded;
- Godot-generated .import and .uid files are excluded and should be regenerated locally;
- internal res:// paths are rewritten only so the staged pack stays self-contained under assets/vfx/third_party/;
- this is a shared asset library import only and is not connected to gameplay automatically.
